description: Send feedback, a bug report or a feature request to the Grabblist team. Only call this when the user asks to report something, or agrees after you offer to report a problem (parsing failure, broken URL, missing feature); show them the message first. Be specific about what went wrong and where.

error.description: Error message you received, if any

message.description: What happened or what you propose. Be specific — the team reads this.

tool.description: The tool you were using when the issue occurred (e.g. add_item, search_saved)

type.description: Type: bug (something broken), parsing_failure (price/title/image not extracted), feature_request (wishlist), feedback (general feedback)

url.description: The URL where the issue occurred

name: send_feedback
